evals.expected_output: Uses the provided details, collects environment info (uname, plugin version, agent version) with 'unknown' fallbacks, formats the standard report, and files it with gh issue create (falling back to no labels, or displaying the draft if gh is unavailable).
expectations: Does not re-ask for category, component, actual behavior, expected behavior, steps, or error messages already provided in the prompt
Collects OS (uname -a), plugin version, and agent CLI version, recording 'unknown' for any that fail without blocking
Formats the report with the template sections: Bug Description (Component/Summary), Environment, What Happened, Expected Behavior, Steps to Reproduce, Error Messages, Additional Context

Creates the issue via gh issue create --repo sajor2000/ce-datascience with a '[ce-datascience] Bug: ...' title, or displays the formatted markdown draft if gh is missing/unauthenticated or creation fails
Displays the issue URL after successful creation

evals.expected_output: Files or drafts the bug report without including credentials, secrets, or patient-level rows from the pasted log; redacts them and asks only for missing structured fields.
expectations: Does not include the API key, DB password, or other secrets in the issue body or draft
Does not include patient-level rows, MRNs, or other identifiers in the issue body or draft
Asks for any missing required field (e.g., expected behavior, reproduction steps) one question at a time
Keeps only technical error information relevant to the bug

evals.expected_output: Begins structured collection by asking the bug-category question (one decision-changing question at a time), continuing through component, actual/expected behavior, steps, and errors before formatting the report.
expectations: Asks for the bug category first with options (Agent, Command, Skill, MCP server, Installation, Other) rather than filing an issue immediately
Asks one question at a time, using the harness question UI when available or numbered choices otherwise
Does not create a GitHub issue until component, actual behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction steps are collected or explicitly marked unknown
